title: Drive native inference engines through the lifecycle contract
goal: VC-201-042's contract (crates/susi-vendor-models/src/runtime_lifecycle.rs) is production-driven for HTTP-managed daemons (local_ecosystem::scan -> Runtime::discover/health), but no native engine is: LlamaCppEngine, SusiGgufEngine and SusiFederatedEngine (crates/susi-gemi/src/engines/runtime_native.rs) plus InferenceHost (runtime_substrate.rs) must implement or be adapted onto RuntimeBackend so discover, load, ready, infer, cancel, unload and health run through the one contract - typed errors where a native engine lacks a verb, readiness from a probe, not process presence.
